Run the whole analysis

Source: R/run_pipeline.R
run_pipeline.Rd

Run prep_visits(), clean_weight(), calc_adg(), calc_adfi() and calc_fcr() in a row with the same QC settings.

Usage

run_pipeline(data, station = NULL, qc = qc_config(), verbose = 1)

Arguments

data

Raw station data (see prep_visits()).

station

"nedap", "fire" or NULL to detect it.

qc

QC settings from qc_config().

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).

Value

An object of class ppt_pipeline: a list with visits, weight, adg, adfi and fcr, plus removed (every pig removed, with the step and the reason).

Examples

res <- run_pipeline(fire, qc = qc_config(stage_range = c(60, 120)), verbose = 0)
res
#>

#> • Removed pigs: 1 (see $removed)
